cat.menu_title: 📂 Your categories (this month). Tap one to see its expenses:
del.done: 🗑 All your data has been deleted. Send /start to begin again.
del.warn: ⚠️ This permanently deletes your profile, expenses, incomes and settings. It cannot be undone. Continue?
exp.add_help: ➕ Adding an expense Just send a message: coffee 15000 taxi 22k yesterday lunch 45 000 12.11 15000 (I'll ask the rest) 💰 Income: +1000000 salary
exp.ask_note: 📝 Add a note? Type it, or skip.
exp.bad_date: I couldn't read that date (or it's in the future). Try {hint}, for example 12.11.
exp.not_understood: I couldn't find an amount in that message. Try coffee 15000. /help shows all commands.
export.caption: 📊 Your Excel report for {period}. Tip: forward it to Saved Messages to keep a copy.
flow.use_buttons: Please tap one of the buttons above, or send /cancel to stop.
help.text: 📖 MoneyMate help Add coffee 15000 · taxi 22k yesterday · 15000 (I'll ask) +1000000 salary or /income: log income and split it /undo removes the last entry Look /today · /week · /month /show transport · /show food last month · /show wants /categories · /search uber · /top /balance: money left in each bucket Insights /stats: your habits · /chart: graphs /export: Excel report (also sent monthly) Personal /settings · /profile · /language · /currency · /timezone /setsplit 80 10 10 · /tips · /tiptime · /newcategory /deletedata erases everything
inc.ask_amount: 💰 How much did you receive? For example 1000000 salary.
inc.ask_custom: Send percentages for Needs, Wants, Savings, e.g. 80 10 10. If you send two numbers, Savings gets the rest.
inc.ask_split: 💰 Income: {amount} ({source}) How do you want to split it?
inc.bad_custom: I need two or three numbers, like 80 10 10.
inc.bad_sum: Those add up to {total}%, but they must total 100%. Try again.
inc.confirm_save: ✅ Confirm and save as my usual split
inc.saved_hint: Expenses now draw from these buckets. Check /balance anytime.

insight.no_spend: 🧘 {n} no-spend days out of {days} so far this month.

ob.done_title: ✅ All set, {name}! Here's what I saved:
ob.nice_to_meet: Nice to meet you, {name}! 🙌 A few quick questions so I can tailor tips and budgets for you. Every question can be skipped.
ob.pick_language: 👋 Welcome to MoneyMate! I help you track spending, split your income into budgets and spot your money habits. 🌐 Choose your language:
ob.privacy: 🔒 Your answers are stored only to personalise tips and budgets. See them with /profile, change them any time, or erase everything with /deletedata.
ob.tour: 🚀 Quick tour • Send an expense: coffee 15000 or taxi 22k yesterday • Send only a number (15000) and I'll ask the details • Got paid? +1000000 salary and I'll help you split it • /balance · /month · /show transport · /stats • /help lists everything
